positions.title: Office 365 Support Technician
positions.description:
Handled technical troubleshooting within an enterprise environment, including system crashes, slow-downs and data recoveries. Engaged and tracked Priority 1 issues, with responsibility for the timely documentation, escalation (if appropriate), resolution and closure of trouble tickets 

Utilize superior multitasking and communication skills to simultaneously employ numerous resources to research and resolve customer issues in a timely manner

Troubleshooting complex technical issues being experienced by the customer using the tools provided and troubleshooting knowledge

Contribute to a strong team environment by upholding high work standards and contributing to on-going initiatives to improve service levels

positions.title: Soldier
positions.description:
Responsible for individual training, personal appearance and cleanliness of soldiers.

Ensured all missions were carried out successfully while maintaining the safety of the soldiers.

Responsible for inventory and safe return of issued property.

Coordinated weekly safety meeting including training exercises.
